newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack up on bullish press report.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack up on bullish press report.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc jumped by more than five percent on Friday, lifted by a bullish press report, dealers said.
By 0917 GMT, the shares were up 22p to 451-1/2p in active trading. More than 2.56 million shares changed hands, making them among the most heavily traded in London.
The Daily Telegraph, in a review of the company since its flotation, said Railtrack's subsidiaries were "among the best in the industry to prosper after privatisation."
The paper said the outlook for competitors was less secure.
Dealers also noted that an overhang of stock, which depressed the shares in recent weeks, appears to have been absorbed.
